notes:
Account snapshot: Cascade VaultWorks is a payments-platform company with strict key custody and cross-border data residency requirements. Primary contact is Head of Security (calls via Fireflies). They want a Private VPC deployment where customer-managed keys live in their cloud tenancy or HSM; explicit no-AWS-managed-default-keys preference. Key asks: 1) Support BYOK import for AWS KMS CMKs (import token flow) and/or integration with CloudHSM/partner HSMs (Thales/Entrust) for HSM-backed keys; 2) Azure Key Vault + HSM/Managed HSM option for their EU workloads; 3) GCP KMS support with customer key import and rotation hooks; 4) Envelope encryption with Redwood holding only ephemeral data key material; persistent CMK policies enforced in customer account; 5) Detailed audit logging: all key usage and admin ops forwarded to customer SIEM (CloudWatch/Stackdriver/Azure Monitor) with at-rest+in-transit proofs; 6) KMS rotation policy and automatic key-rolling notifications; 7) FIPS 140-2 level 3 or equivalent for HSM requirement.

Security review status: InfoSec completed initial questionnaire; outstanding items are legal language for key custody in contract, confirmation of how Redwood handles ephemeral keys in runtime, network egress/peering diagrams. They asked: "Can Redwood run with HSM-protected CMKs in our AWS account and never take custody of CMKs?" — AE response: yes, with envelope encryption and strict access controls, but need SE to validate cross-account role permissions.

POC plan (proposed): 3-week sandbox in customer's VPC: week 1 - networking & IAM (VPC peering, cross-account role, KMS policies); week 2 - import test keys (AWS KMS import and Azure Managed HSM), run sample workload (embeddings + low-latency chat); week 3 - audit logging verification, rotation test, performance measurements. Acceptance criteria: successful low-latency inference <120ms p50 for chat path, verified key usage logs in customer SIEM, documented key rotation with zero downtime for tokens.

Stated blockers from customer: procurement Q2 budget window, legal needs specific BYOK/HSM clause, timeline for their HSM procurement (if choosing partner HSM), IAM role approvals in their security council.

Action items for Redwood: 1) Schedule SE deep-dive (network + KMS flow) — target date next week; 2) Produce BYOK/HSM integration spec (include AWS KMS import steps, CloudHSM connector approach, Azure Key Vault Managed HSM guidance, GCP KMS import caveats); 3) Draft SOW with timelines and PII residency commitments; 4) Provide sample KMS policies and IAM role JSON for their security review.
short_description: Enterprise fintech evaluating Redwood Private in VPC with strict BYOK/HSM requirements across AWS/Azure/GCP; running security review + POC. Focus: KMS/HSM integrations, audit logging, data residency, key rotation and custody language.
